featured_reviews.name: Shaikh Abbas
featured_reviews.review_text:
5★ — A love-at-first-bite burger spot!
Tried the OG Smash Burger and the wings — both were absolutely fantastic. The beef is juicy, perfectly seasoned, and melts in your mouth; the wings are crispy with bold, addictive flavor. Quality and taste are top-notch — honestly, some of the best comfort food I’ve had in a while.

Service is fast and friendly. If you’re picking up, order ahead and arrive at the pickup time they give — saves waiting. The only downside is the in-shop atmosphere, so I’d recommend delivery via Zomato/Swiggy or takeaway if you want a relaxed experience. One note: if you don’t like strong beef flavors, skip their “buff” menu items.

Quick highlights:
Standouts: OG Smash Burger, wings.
Service: fast and reliable.
Best way to eat: delivery or takeaway.
Would I go back? Absolutely — highly recommended!

The space itself was clean, organized, and comfortably spacious, which adds greatly to the overall impression. It’s evident that management takes pride in maintaining service and hygiene standards.

Highly recommended for anyone seeking a consistently good quick-service experience. If Burger King continues this standard across outlets, it’s bound to earn even stronger customer loyalty and repeat business.

I will recommend to give this place a try. They have a lot of options like different sauce french fries, pizzas, burgers, pastas,etc.

-We had veg white sauce pasta,it tastes amazing.
-Veg mexican pizza( Regular size is a bit small, so order as per your requirement)
-Veg steamed momos (My absolute favourite from this place)

The place is a bit crowded around 8 to 10 pm.

P.S. The momo stall is outside this eatery outlet, 'Crime Master Momo'. They charge 20 rupees extra if you order by sitting inside the eatery, both the momos and their sauce were delicious 🤤.

featured_reviews.name: Neha Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: The atmosphere and seating is only good, rest of Vaishali Nagar is full of strong competition in fast food and cheezy bytzz needs to stand up well. We had ordered french fries and chicken popcorn. Just a small 6 inches plate and countable french fries saltless was served costing 100 RUPEES and pathetic chicken popcorn was a McCain packet of ready to fry and eat types costing around 130 RUPEES. Vaishali has other good options than cheezy bytzz that people should explore, save your hard earned money and eat somewhere worth the price
